_comment: Trade-entry gates for HSI morning session. ALL gates must pass before manual Y/N. Manual Y/N is still the final binding gate (mirrors US pattern).

vhsi_regime.description: Skip session if HSI volatility index is in panic or dead-zone regime

a50_correlation.description: China A50 and HSI futures must agree on direction in the first 15 min after HK open

china_policy_blackout.description: No entries within ±30 min of scheduled PBoC / Politburo / major China data releases

session_window.description: Only trade during defined HSI session windows

daily_trade_cap.description: Hard cap on trades per session. DISABLED 2026-06-02 per user (no trade cap on watchers). Binding gate is manual_dashboard_yn. Re-enable by setting enabled:true.

manual_dashboard_yn.description: Binding final gate — dashboard Y/N toggle. Mirrors US setup.

correlation_chase_filter.description: Reject entries that are 'chase trades' — late entry on a fast move already in progress
correlation_chase_filter._inspiration: Mirrors the US chase-trade diagnosis (May 1 post-mortem)
